description: Check a composition (layers), design (elements), or improvement patch (add/change/remove/sfx) and return actionable errors and warnings. Rejects measurable text that cannot fit the canvas safe area, text that crosses the canvas, and line-height below 1. Warns when a code layer or component declares a name the engine already provides (RESERVED_NAME_DECLARED). This is not proof of a successful render.

composition.description: Optional original composition used to resolve patch references and timings.

json.description: HyperCodeMotion JSON object or JSON-encoded string to validate.

name: validate_json
title: Validate HyperCodeMotion JSON
